titolo: Why the Deep Amazon Is Still Off Limits to Humans

scene.testo: Parts of the Amazon have likely never seen outsiders.
Satellites can photograph every treetop. Yet nobody walks there.
Brazil forbids outsiders from entering these protected lands.
Why? The answer is not only the jungle.
Some people here have chosen to avoid contact.
Brazil has more uncontacted groups than any other country.
But that's not the strangest part of this story.
First, the scale of this forest is staggering.
The Amazon River carries more water than any river on Earth.
Yet no bridge crosses its main channel.
Floods swallow trails and turn forest into lake.
Heat, insects and tangled vegetation make every mile exhausting.
Deep inside, the canopy blocks much of the sunlight.
The forest shelters about one in ten known species.
Jaguars, snakes and caimans hide beyond the riverbanks.
Even so, danger is not the main barrier.
Entering could carry diseases that devastate isolated communities.
Stay with me, and I'll show you exactly why.
